contexts.text: The ziim, etc. () = the interiors of (Babel) worship; for such things are of the love of self.
The ziim, and lira, and daughters of the owl () = evils and falsities, thus the things that, inwardly, are of death. ( = infernal falsities and evils. AE 587:10.)
The people of the ziim () = those in falsities, or the falsities themselves. ( = those in infernal falsities. AE 483:end.)
The ziim, etc. = various concupiscences. Illustrated.
The tziim and iim () = corporeal concupiscences.
